sections.text: مقدمة

This document outlines the equipment inspection 
I1, which must be performed every six months as indicated by M6 in above title 
block.

The working principle of the liquid ring vacuum 
pump is dependent upon a continuous supply of clean seal liquid which is 
normally water the seal liquid enters the pump through a connection on the 
casing and is discharged from the pump .

The first draft 
initiated by Eng. Mahmoud Abou El-Fetouh Shata, tested by eng. Ali Abd El-Salam, and 
revised by MDEPC quality control engineer Abouda Elbana , accepted by general 
director eng. Yosry Abd El-Maqsood, and approved by eng. Farouk Awad head 
sector of Talkha Power Station .

This document accepted by Eng. Samir Abd El-Gilil 
MDEPC inspection & quality control general director MPIS coordinator & certified 
by accountant Mohamed Nageb MDEPC admin . & financial prediction head sector & 
supervisor of inspection & quality control head sector .
